Ability Rehabilitation believes in placing the well-being of our patients first. We accomplish this through carefully selecting a staff of compassionate, dedicated, and team-oriented therapists. In fact, our company is owned and operated by this team.

From your very first visit, it’s our priority to address your needs, provide personalized care and create an individual treatment plan that will help you move safer, smarter and stronger. Bilingual staff available at most offices.
